<a id="init_sound"></a>
### [`init_sound`](../../../../src/sound/sid.asm#L6) `$9D26`

*routine*

Silences the SID. Clears the SID shadow, the driver workspace $0200-$0259 and the driver variables $cf-$ee.

- **Called from:** [`start`](../init/init.md#start), [`stop_sound`](stop_sound.md#stop_sound)

### [`effects_tick`](../../../../src/sound/sid.asm#L38) `$9D52`

*routine*
